notes: Journal article (J Porous Mater 2008, 15:625-633), not a review; is_retracted false in record.json; no statement that the H2 data were published before. The carbon sorbent is a carbon molecular sieve hollow fibre made by carbonizing P84 co-polyimide at 1173 K; the paper gives no elemental composition but calls it a carbon membrane throughout (treated as carbon sorbent). H2 uptake is only an isotherm in Fig. 6 (about 6.6 mmol/g at 1 bar, 77 K, read by eye, no table value); adsorption/desorption shown. Surface area 560 m2/g is a Langmuir value from the H2 isotherm at 77 K on the same sample; N2 BET at 77 K gave negligible uptake, and CO2 BET/Langmuir areas of 525-625 m2/g are also given (Section 3.3, p. 630).
